title: Drowning in Sounds of slow thought. While shouting out Only brings pressure, wind rising waves. Stillness begots stillness #smallpoems #mb
summary: Drowning in Sounds of slow thought. While shouting out Only brings pressure, wind rising waves. Stillness begots stillness #smallpoems #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Drowning in
Sounds of slow
thought.
While shouting
out
Only brings pressure, wind
rising waves.
Stillness begots
stillness

#smallpoems #mb
